title: Data and code for evidence gating in gut microbial biotransformation inference
description: Reproducibility materials for four computational case studies of microbial biotransformation evidence, AGORA2 model compatibility, type 2 diabetes metagenomic pathway associations, and source-defined Rb1 converter groups. This version excludes raw reads, AGORA2 model files, SILVA reference files, restricted third-party row-level inputs, submission documents, and internal review records.
